notes.title: Update - Mid June
notes.content:
Hey all !

With the steam games festival coming up I've been trying to fix up stuff and get a good build ready for everyone to try out !
I'm glad to say that so far we are good to go !

I can't wait for the games festival to begin and people trying out my game.

Improvements made : 

- Added visibility to connections, wired look
- Coin and other resources disappearing when fallen out of a tree or other sources.
- Made resource breaking quicker
- Added variations to enemies
- Stone walls now stop projectiles as it should be.
- Made couple of quests to kick-start the beginning of the game.
- Completely removed Motion blur
- Markets are now expensive (x10 times)
- Player can now also sell to markets
- Consumable Traps are here !


There were plenty bugs which have been removed or worked around so players wont see them in game.

I will be live streaming on Steam or Twitch everyday for the Steam games Festival from 11am-2pm PDT.

Enjoy the festival and stay safe !

notes.title: 1st week of June Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone !

Hope you all are well and safe.
I must say this first and foremost whatever happened in the USA was wrong and more strength to the affected and the people who are willing to eradicate these issues.

The update I've made is for the main game but also for the demo so everyone is free to try it out.
Kindly note whoever is playing the demo, leave some kind of comment on twitter or youtube or steam so I know what you liked and disliked in the game,

Better menus
Options menu
Overhauling of controls
Completely new simpler tutorial or learning quests
Quests but only 2 for training. Bigger quests and game story quests may come later.

and many solved numerous bugs.

I thank you all for trying my game. 
Have a great weekend.

notes.title: HMD - Devlog 2
notes.content:
TLDW : Too long didnt watch plus the audio is bad in the video so here is the summary of what all has been done so far.

Features :
Save system
Options menu
Complete resource collection of Wood, Iron and Stone.
All trees interactable.
Balancing of resource collection
Balanced day time. 


Bugs solved
- Drop traps now working
Anvirl drop, rabbit trap, etc.
Selected traps can now be built on triggers
Connections have ui to confirm which traps are being connected and the trap and trigger are highlighted.
Removed a few graphics glitches and foliage issues.
Increased the walk speed and run speed.


Youtube video : [previewyoutube=4B3LcCQVPAo;full][/previewyoutube]
